title: Install a single-codon change (APOE R176C) by HDR
label: R176C (CGC>TGC)
objectives: Choose HDR with ssODNs, not a knockout, for a one-codon change.
Place both guides close to the edit so HDR is not limited by cut-to-edit distance.
Silently block re-cutting of the repaired allele for both guides.
Tell the intended edit apart from clones that carry only the silent blocking changes.
caveats: Teaching case built from a reference fixture in the Design repo's test suite; it is not annotated against ClinVar or any patient.
The reference file's licence/provenance has not been reviewed for redistribution.

The 1,070 bp design window occurs exactly once in the public RefSeqGene record NG_007084.2 (0 mismatches; see data/verification_grch38.csv and test/ui-data.test.js). The fixture file itself is still described by the caveat above.
